abstract:
AI agents now search, negotiate, and transact for firms and customers, reshaping how marketing relationships form and evolve. We introduce
                    Business to Agent to Customer (B2A2C) marketing
                    , a triadic exchange structure in which firms and their AI agents interact directly with customers and their AI agents. B2A2C rests on delegation, multiplicity, and infrastructural mediation, and creates coordination and governance problems that existing marketing theories do not fully address. To explain relationship management in these markets, we propose
                    Customer-Agent Relationship Marketing (CARMA)
                    , an organic marketing theory built around five interdependent mechanisms: calibration, accountability, reciprocity, mediation, and adaptivity. CARMA departs from relationship marketing and principal-agent theory by treating exchange not as direct firm-customer interaction or single-agent alignment, but as a system in which both sides delegate to learning agents governed together. We develop eight propositions on the antecedents of delegation, the relational failures arising without CARMA’s mechanisms, and how these mechanisms vary by context and agent capability. We argue that trust becomes an ex-ante condition, infrastructure and machine-readable reciprocity shape loyalty through protocol design, and that alignment across human, infrastructural, and agentic layers becomes a source of competitive advantage. We close with six CARMA KPIs and a CARMA Readiness Assessor for evaluating B2A2C readiness.

ob.ai_reason: 智能体AI与B2A2C营销架构，核心AI议题
ob.tldr: 论文提出AI智能体代为搜索、谈判与交易背景下，企业与客户经由AI中介互动的新交换结构B2A2C，并构建客户—智能体关系营销理论CARMA，围绕校准、问责、互惠、媒介、调适五大机制展开，提出八项命题论述委托前置条件、关系失败与情境差异，主张信任转为先行条件、机器可读互惠塑造忠诚、人—基础设施—智能体三层协同构成竞争优势来源。

ur.ai_reason: 核心为Agentic AI营销，概念性框架
ur.tldr: 提出B2A2C（企业-智能体-消费者）三方营销交换结构与CARMA（消费者-智能体关系营销）有机理论，涵盖校准、问责、互惠、媒介、调适五大机制。提出八项命题，论述委托前置条件、关系失败模式与机制的情境差异，主张信任转为前置条件、协议化机器可读互惠塑造忠诚、人-基础设施-智能体三层对齐构成竞争优势。

title: EXPRESS: Agentic AI and the New Architecture of Marketing Relationships
title_zh: EXPRESS：Agentic AI与营销关系的新架构
